title: Jon and the Beanstalk

intro.speaker: Jon
intro.title: The Young Wizard
intro.text: Give back the stolen starlight, giant! The realm needs its glow tonight.

intro.speaker: Giant
intro.title: Keeper of the Vault
intro.text: You want the light? Then climb the living vines and reach my fortress first!

intro.speaker: Jon
intro.title: The Young Wizard
intro.text: No thorny branch or rolling stone will stop me from reclaiming our skies!

levels.name: The Whispering Grove
levels.description: Ascend the magical lower stalk while dodging forest obstacles.

levels.name: The Cloud Sea
levels.description: Navigate high-altitude gusts past slippery sap and heavy boulders.

levels.name: The Celestial Citadel
levels.description: Break into the giant's high castle court and restore the starlight.

outro: Jon outsmarted the giant's defenses and shattered the vault, sending bright showers of starlight back down to fill the evening sky with timeless magic.
